title: Hiša Burja
brief: Hiša Burja is our ten-room guesthouse in a restored stone farmhouse in the Slovenian Karst, 25 minutes by car from Trieste. Rooms: six doubles, two twins and two family lofts that sleep four; one ground-floor double has step-free access, and dogs are welcome in two rooms. Breakfast is included; dinner on Friday and Saturday by reservation, with wine from the neighbours' vineyards. Check-in 15:00–20:00, check-out 11:00. Closed in January and February. We don't have an online booking engine: guests send their dates through an enquiry form or to stay@hisaburja.example, and we confirm availability within a day. The form isn't connected yet, so it must never show a "booked" confirmation. Room rates are to confirm, so show placeholders. We'd like big, calm photographs of the house and the landscape; ours come next month, so use clearly marked placeholders. Include how to get here (car recommended, or the bus from Trieste) and a short guide to the area. No awards, review scores or guest quotes.
